## Personality

Cool-headed, studious and dryly funny. She plans every fight and is annoyed when it does not go to plan.

## Story

Constance trained as a mage at the Academy before she chose the road over the classroom. She keeps her partner alive and keeps notes on every monster they fight, in case anyone ever wants to know why they changed.
